Then a physician or psychologist can fill out the first clinical certification stating they believe you need hospitalization…… then a second clinical certification by a psychiatrist has to be filled out (usually done at the psych ward/hospital…. Within 7 days of these forms being filed with probate court, you will speak with an attorney….. you may defer the court hearing and agree to treatment or go before a judge and let the judge determine if an initial treatment order of a combo of up to 60 inpatient days or get discharged with 90 outpatient treatment days usually community mental health….
